name: grpc-cpp
description: Official C++ reference gRPC implementation (grpc/grpc core)

upstream_pin.notes: Official C++ reference peer pinned in tests/interop/cases.json

server.description: Official C++ gRPC interop server (from scripts/grpc-interop-cpp.sh)

client.description: Official C++ gRPC interop client (from scripts/grpc-interop-cpp.sh)

matching_configuration.cores: matched pinned cores; effective quota recorded per run
matching_configuration.http2_windows: official grpc-core peer defaults (not pinned by the harness; recorded per run)
matching_configuration.message_limits: official peer defaults; 4 MiB native-side worker body cap
matching_configuration.deadlines: interop-soak client defaults with 5000 ms per-iteration ceiling; 5 s native-side worker deadline
matching_configuration.handler_work: official interop TestService handlers; same procedures and payloads as native

tls.notes: Server loads test credentials via the upstream credentials provider. The native generator verifies with third_party/grpc/src/core/tsi/test_creds/ca.pem and server name foo.test.google.fr (pinned by test_credentials_provider.cc). Resolved by bench/stack-matrix/peertls.py.
